transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here because my sleep has gotten really messed up. Some nights I’m up for half the night with my mind running, and other times I wake up way too early and feel like I barely rested.
Aside from your sleep, how has your mood been lately?
Lately I’ve been feeling pretty low. I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, and even being in my condo—something I worked really hard for—can just make me want to cry.
How long have you been feeling this low?
About five months, I think. It’s been this depressed, guilty fog for that whole time, though it got a lot worse after I bought the condo.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or on top of the world, without needing much sleep?
Yeah. There were several nights where I only slept maybe three or four hours, but I still got up feeling really charged. I didn’t even feel like I needed coffee.
How long did that period of feeling charged and needing less sleep last?
It’s been about a month—the obvious switching between feeling really charged and then crashing. It started around when the mortgage became real.
During those times when you felt so charged, did your thoughts feel like they were racing or moving much faster than usual?
Yes. My thoughts would jump from the mortgage payments to my CPA study schedule to the kitchen cabinets so fast I couldn’t slow them down enough to relax.
During those times when you felt so energized, did it cause any significant problems with your work or personal relationships?
I’m still getting to work, but I’ve made enough reconciliation mistakes that my supervisor pulled me aside. And I’ve been avoiding salsa class and my friends because I just don’t feel like myself.
During the times when you felt so energized, did you do anything uncharacteristic or risky, such as reckless spending or impulsive decisions?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I did anything especially reckless—I just felt more keyed up than usual.
During either the charged periods or the low periods, have you ever heard or seen things that others couldn't hear or see?
No, I haven’t noticed hearing or seeing things that other people don’t.
Have you ever needed to be hospitalized or go to the emergency room because of these mood changes?
No, I haven’t needed to go to the hospital or emergency room for it.
Have you been drinking alcohol or using any recreational drugs?
I’m not really sure what you mean by recreational drugs. I haven’t noticed alcohol or anything like that being a big part of this.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a current persistent depressive episode lasting approximately 5 months (low mood, feelings of guilt and emptiness, crying spells) alongside distinct periods of elevated energy with a decreased need for sleep (3-4 hours without fatigue) and racing thoughts lasting several days, alternating with crashes over the past month. This distinct history of hypomanic/manic symptoms and depressive episodes confirms the diagnosis of Bipolar affective disorder (F31).
